messages:
lara: Noticing brief apiserver 502s in ap-south-1 since 08:42 UTC, also seeing controller-manager lease renew failures and a spike of PodAttach timeouts for GPU nodes.

ops-bot: [ALERT] controller-manager: lease renew failures (ap-south-1) 08:44:10Z

diego: quick metrics: gateway-nat-01 conntrack_count ~ 64700, ephemeral port exhaustion warnings, lots of TCP_RST to 10.0.0.5:6443.

zack: that pattern -> egress SNAT depletion causing controlplane connection resets and leader election churn.

lara: paste ctrlmgr log snippet:
```
E0305 08:43:58 leaderelection.go: error retrieving resource lock: dial tcp 10.0.0.5:6443: i/o timeout
W0305 08:44:00 lease_renew.go: failed to renew lease: context deadline exceeded
```

infra-bot: Recommended mitigations: add secondary NAT gateway, patch controller-manager lease flags for region canary, and tune conntrack timeouts.

diego: I'll provision second NAT and update route table; ETA ~5m. I'll also open infra ticket to autoscale NAT or move controlplane egress to NAT gateway pair.

lara: I'll apply canary patch to kube-controller-manager in ap-south-1: `--leader-elect-lease-duration=40s --leader-elect-renew-deadline=30s`.

ops-bot: deploy started for controller-manager canary (ap-south-1).

zack: After canary and adding NAT, reconcile latency normalized in ~60s and attach timeouts dropped.

diego: cost note: extra NAT ~ $110/mo in ap-south-1. tagging finance.

lara: Action items: 1) infra: autoscale NAT / avoid single gateway 2) infra: tune conntrack tcp timeouts 3) platform: add synthetic lease-renew probe + alert 4) runbook update for GPU attach fallbacks. Paul will own postmortem.

zack: moving to postmortem channel. :white_check_mark:
